title: Muhammad [pbuh] ka Nasab aur Khandan
arabicTitle: نسب النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وأسرته

topics.title: Nabwi Khandan

paragraphs.text: Nabi Muhammad (Peace be upon him) ke nasab ke baare mein teen riwayatein hain: Pehli riwayat ko seerat-nigaron aur nasab-shanason ne sahih maana hai, aur is mein Muhammad ka silsila-nasab 'Adnan tak pohnchaya gaya hai. Doosri riwayat ikhtilaf aur shak ki zad mein hai, aur is mein aap ka nasab 'Adnan se aage Ibrahim tak le jaaya gaya hai. Teesri riwayat, jis ke kuch hisse yaqeenan ghalat hain, aap ka nasab Ibrahim se aage Adam (Peace be upon him) tak le jaati hai.

Is mukhtasar jaayze ke baad, ab tafseelat zaroori samjhi jaati hain. Pehla hissa: Muhammad bin 'Abdullah bin 'Abdul-Muttalib (jinhein Shaiba kaha jaata tha) bin Hashim, (jin ka naam 'Amr tha) bin 'Abd Munaf (jinhein Al-Mugheera kaha jaata tha) bin Qusai (jinhein Zaid bhi kaha jaata tha) bin Kilab bin Murra bin Ka'b bin Lo'i bin Ghalib bin Fahr (jinhein Quraish kaha jaata tha aur jin ke naam par un ka qabeela mashhoor hua) bin Malik bin An-Nadr (jinhein Qais kaha jaata tha) bin Kinana bin Khuzaiman bin Mudrikah (jinhein 'Amir kaha jaata tha) bin Elias bin Mudar bin Nizar bin Ma'ad bin 'Adnan.

Doosra hissa: 'Adnan bin Add bin Humaisi' bin Salaman bin Aws bin Buz bin Qamwal bin Obai bin 'Awwam bin Nashid bin Haza bin Bildas bin Yadlaf bin Tabikh bin Jahim bin Nahish bin Makhi bin Aid bin 'Abqar bin 'Ubaid bin Ad-Da'a bin Hamdan bin Sanbir bin Yathrabi bin Yahzin bin Yalhan bin Ar'awi bin Aid bin Deshan bin Aisar bin Afnad bin Aiham bin Muksar bin Nahith bin Zarih bin Sami bin Mazzi bin 'Awda bin Aram bin Qaidar bin Ishmael son of Abraham (Peace be upon them).

Teesra hissa: Ibrahim (Peace be upon him) se aage, Ibn Tarih (Azar) bin Nahur bin Saru' bin Ra'u bin Falikh bin Abir bin Shalikh bin Arfakhshad bin Sam bin Noah (Peace be upon him), bin Lamik bin Mutwashlack bin Akhnukh [jin ke baare mein kaha jaata hai ke wo Nabi Idris (Enoch) (Peace be upon him) the] bin Yarid bin Mahla'il bin Qabin Anusha bin Shith bin Adam (Peace be upon him).
Nabi Muhammad (Peace be upon him) ke khandan ko un ke daada Hashim bin 'Abd Munaf ki nisbat se Hashimi khandan kaha jaata hai. Aaiye ab Hashim aur un ki aulaad ke baare mein thoda zikr karein.

Hashim: Jaisa ke ham pehle zikr kar chuke hain, wo hujjaaj ko khaana aur paani pohnchaane ke zimmedaar the. Yeh zimmedaari un ke paas tab aayi jab 'Abd Munaf aur 'Abd Ad-Dar ki aulaad ke darmiyan zimmedaariyon ki taqseem par samjhauta hua. Hashim daulatmand aur emandaar the. Wo pehle shakhs the jinhone hujjaaj ko shorbe mein bheega hua bread (roti) pesh kiya. Un ka asli naam 'Amr tha lekin unhein Hashim kaha jaane laga kyunki un ki aadat (hujjaaj ke liye) roti chooran ki thi. Wo pehle shakhs bhi the jinhone Quraish ke do safar — garmi aur sardi ke — shuru kiye. Riwayat hai ke wo tijaarat ke liye Syria gaye. Madinah mein, unhone Salma se shaadi ki — jo Bani 'Adi bin An-Najjar ki 'Amr ki beti thi. Unhone Madinah mein un ke saath kuch waqt guzaara phir dobara Syria rawana ho gaye jabki wo haamila theen. Wo 497 A.D. mein Palestine ke Ghazza mein faut hue. Baad mein, un ki biwi ne 'Abdul-Muttalib ko janam diya aur un ke sar ke safed baal ki wajah se un ka naam Shaiba rakha, aur un ki parwarish Madinah mein apne walid ke ghar mein ki. Makkah mein un ke khandan mein se kisi ko un ki paidaish ka pata nahi chala. Hashim ke chaar bete the; Asad, Abu Saifi, Nadla aur 'Abdul-Muttalib, aur paanch betiyaan Ash-Shifa, Khalida, Da'ifa, Ruqyah aur Jannah.

'Abdul-Muttalib: Ham pehle hi jaan chuke hain ke Hashim ki wafaat ke baad, hujjaaj ke khaane aur paani ki zimmedaari un ke bhai Al-Muttalib bin 'Abd Munaf (jo emandaar, sakhi aur qaabil-e-bharosa the) ke paas chali gayi. Jab 'Abdul-Muttalib larakpan ki umar ko pohnche, to un ke chacha Al-Muttalib ne un ke baare mein suna aur unhein laane ke liye Madinah gaye. Jab unhone unhein dekha, to un ki aankhein aansuon se bhar gayeen aur gaalon par beh nikleen, unhone unhein gale lagaya aur apne oont par bitha liya. Lekin larke ne un ke saath Makkah jaane se inkaar kiya jab tak ke un ki maa ki ijaazat na le. Al-Muttalib ne un ki maa se kaha ke larke ko un ke saath Makkah bhej dein, lekin unhone inkaar kar diya. Unhone unhein yeh keh kar razi kar liya: "Aap ka beta Makkah ja raha hai apne walid ki sardari bahaal karne, aur Bait-ul-Haram ke qareeb rehne." Wahan Makkah mein, log Abdul-Muttalib ko dekh kar hairan hue, aur unhone unhein Muttalib ka ghulam samjha. Al-Muttalib ne kaha: "Yeh mera bhateeja hai, mere bhai Hashim ka beta." Larke ki parwarish Al-Muttalib ke ghar mein hui, lekin baad mein Al-Muttalib Yemen ke Bardman mein faut ho gaye to 'Abdul-Muttalib ne zimmedaari sambhaali aur apni qaum ki shaan ko qaayam rakha aur apne sharaafat bhare kirdaar mein apne daadaon se aage nikal gaye jis ne unhein Makkah ki gehri muhabbat aur uchi izzat dilaayi.

Jab Al-Muttalib faut hue, Nawfal ne 'Abdul-Muttalib se un ki zimmedaariyan chheen leen, to unhone Quraish se madad maangi lekin unhone dono mein se kisi ko bhi kisi qism ki taa'eed dene se inkaar kar diya. Chunaancha unhone apne Bani An-Najjar ke maamuon (apni maa ke bhaiyon) ko khat likha ke un ki madad ko aayein. Un ke maamun, Abu Sa'd bin 'Adi (un ki maa ke bhai) assi sawaron ke sath Makkah ki taraf rawana hue aur Makkah ke Abtah mein parao kiya. 'Abdul-Muttalib ne un logon ka istaqbaal kiya aur unhein apne ghar chalne ki da'wat di lekin Abu Sa'd ne kaha: "Pehle main Nawfal se milun." Unhone Nawfal ko Al-Ka'bah ke saaye mein Quraish ke kuch boorhon ke saath baitha paaya. Abu Sa'd ne apni talwar nikaali aur kaha: "Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ke agar tum ne mere bhateeje ka jo tum ne liya hai wo wapas na kiya, to main tumhein is talwar se qatl kar dunga." Yun Nawfal majboor ho gaya ke jo us ne chheena tha wo chhor de, aur Quraish ke sardaron ko us ke alfaaz ka gawah banaaya gaya.

Abu Sa'd phir 'Abdul-Muttalib ke ghar gaye jahan wo teen raatein ruke, 'Umra kiya aur Madinah wapas chale gaye. Baad mein, Nawfal ne Bani Hashim ke khilaaf Bani 'Abd Shams bin 'Abd Munaf ke saath gathjor kar liya. Jab Khuza'a, ek qabeele, ne Bani An-Najjar ki 'Abdul-Muttalib ko taa'eed dekhi to unhone kaha: "Wo hamaara beta hai jaise tumhaara hai. Hamaare paas us ki madad karne ki tum se zyada wajooh hain." 'Abd Munaf ki maa un mein se ek thi. Wo An-Nadwa House mein gaye aur Bani 'Abd Shams aur Nawfal ke khilaaf Bani Hashim ke saath gathjor kar liya. Yeh wo gathjor tha jo baad mein fatah-e-Makkah ki asal wajah bana.

'Abdul-Muttalib ne apni zindagi mein do aham waaqiat dekhe, ya'ni Zamzam kuwen ki khudaai aur Hathi ka hamla. Mukhtasaran, 'Abdul-Muttalib ko khwaab mein hukm mila ke ek khaas jagah par Zamzam ka kuwaan khoden. Unhone aisa hi kiya aur wo cheezein paayeen jo Jurhum ke logon ne wahan dafan ki theen jab unhein Makkah khaali karne par majboor kiya gaya tha. Unhone talwarein, zirhein aur sone ke do hiran paaye. Al-Ka'bah ka darwaza sone ki talwaron aur do hiranon se sajaya gaya aur phir hujjaaj ko Zamzam ka paani pohnchaane ki rivaayat qaayam hui.

Jab Zamzam ka kuwaan paani uglaane laga, Quraish ne is kaam mein shirakat ka daawa kiya, lekin 'Abdul-Muttalib ne un ke mutaalbat is bunyaad par radd kar diye ke Allah ne is mu'azzaz kaam ke liye sirf unhein chuna hai. Jhagra hal karne ke liye, wo Bani Sa'd ke kaahin se mashwara karne par raazi hue. Raaste mein, Allah ne unhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhaayeen jinhone is muqaddas chashme ke baare mein 'Abdul-Muttalib ke haq ki tasdeeq ki. Tabhi 'Abdul-Muttalib ne ek pukhta nazar maani ke agar un ke das bete hue to wo apne ek baaligh bachche ko Al-Ka'bah ke liye qurban karenge.

Doosra waaqia Abraha As-Sabah Al-Habashi, Yemen mein Habshi (Ethiopian) gawarnar, ka tha. Us ne dekha tha ke Arab Al-Ka'bah ka hajj karte hain to us ne San'a mein ek bara church banaaya taake Arab hujjaaj ko Makkah ke bajaaye us ki taraf khaiñche. Kinana qabeele ke ek shakhs ne is chaal ko samjha, isliye wo raat ke waqt chupke se church mein dakhil hua aur us ki aage waali deewaar ko gandagi se leep diya. Jab Abraha ko is ka pata chala, to wo bohot ghussa hua aur Al-Ka'bah ko dhaane ke liye ek bari fauj — saath hazaar jangjuon ki — le kar nikla. Us ne apne liye sab se bara hathi chuna. Us ki fauj mein nau ya terah hathi shaamil the. Wo chalta raha yahan tak ke ek jagah pohncha jise Al-Magmas kaha jaata hai. Wahan, us ne apni fauj ko muntazam kiya, apne hathi tayyar kiye aur Makkah mein dakhil hone ke liye taiyar hua. Jab wo Muzdalifah aur Mina ke darmiyan Muhassar waadi pohncha, to hathi baith gaya aur aage barhne se inkaar kar diya. Jab bhi wo use shimaal, junoob ya mashriq ki taraf moradte, to hathi tezi se chalta lekin jab use mashrib (paschim) ki taraf Al-Ka'bah ki taraf moradte, to wo baith jaata. Isi dauran, Allah ne un par parindon ke ghol bhej diye, jo un par pakki mitti ke patthar phenk rahe the aur unhein khaaye hue hare bhuse ki tarah bana diya.

Yeh parinde bohot kuch ababeelon aur chirion ki tarah the, har ek teen patthar uthaaye hue; ek apni chonch mein aur do apne panjon mein. Patthar Abraha ke aadmiyon ko lagte aur un ke a'za kaat dete aur unhein maar dete. Is tarah Abraha ke sipaahiyon ki ek bari taadaad maari gayi aur baaki idhar udhar bhaag gaye aur har jagah mar gaye. Khud Abraha ko ek aisi bemaari lagi jis ne us ki ungliyon ke sire kaat diye. Jab wo San'a pohncha to wo bohot kharaab haalat mein tha aur jald hi mar gaya. Quraishi apni jaanen bachaane ke liye teeliyon aur pahaaron ki chotiyon par bhaag gaye the. Jab dushman is tarah shikast khaa gaya, to wo bakhairiyat ghar wapas aaye.

Hathi ka waaqia Al-Muharram ke maheene mein pesh aaya, Nabi Muhammad (Peace be upon him) ki wiladat se pachaas ya pachpan din pehle jo akhir February ya shuru March 571 A.D. ke mutaabiq tha. Yeh Allah ki taraf se apne Nabi aur un ke khandan ke liye ek tohfa tha. Ise dar-haqeeqat aane waale noor ki ek Ilaahi mubaarak peshgi alaamat samjha ja sakta hai jo Nabi aur un ke khandan ki aamad ke saath aane waali thi. Is ke bar-aks, Jerusalem Allah ke dushmanon ke zulm ke nigze tale takleef uthaa raha tha. Yahan ham B.C. 587 mein Bukhtanassar aur 70 A.D. mein Romiyon ko yaad kar sakte hain. Al-Ka'bah, Ilaahi rehmat se, kabhi Eesaaiyon — us waqt ke Muslims — ke qabze mein nahi aayi agarche Makkah mein mushrikeen aabaad the.

Hathi waaqie ki khabar us waqt ki mutamaddin duniya ke door door ke konon tak pohnchi. Habsha (Ethiopia) ke Romiyon ke saath mazboot ta'alluqaat the, jabki doosri taraf Eraani, samaaji-siyaasi ufuq par mandlaane waali kisi bhi strateji tabdeeli ke baare mein chaukanne the, aur jald hi Yemen par qaabiz ho gaye. Ittefaaq se, us waqt Romi aur Eraani saltanatein taaqatwar mutamaddin duniya ki numaayindagi karti theen. Hathi ke hamle ke waaqie ne duniya ki tawajjo Allah ke ghar ki taqaddus ki taraf maboot kar di, aur dikhaaya ke is ghar ko Allah ne us ki izzat ke liye chuna hai. Phir yeh nateeja nikalta tha ke agar is ke logon mein se koi nubuwwat ka daawa kare, to wo Hathi waaqie ke nateeje ke mutaabiq hoga, aur us posheeda Ilaahi hikmat ki ek jaayaz tashreeh faraham karega jo Eesaaiyon ke khilaaf mushrikeen ki aisi taa'eed ke peeche thi jo sabab aur nateeje ke faarmoole se aage thi.

'Abdul-Muttalib ke das bete the, Al-Harith, Az-Zubair, Abu Talib, 'Abdullah, Hamzah, Abu Lahab, Ghidaq, Maqwam, Safar aur Al-'Abbas. Un ki cheh betiyaan bhi theen, jo theen Umm Al-Hakim — wahid safed rang waali, Barrah, 'Atikah, Safiya, Arwa aur Omaima.

'Abdullah: Nabi Muhammad (Peace be upon him) ke walid. Un ki maa Fatimah theen, jo 'Amr bin 'A'idh bin 'Imran bin Makhzum bin Yaqdha bin Murra ki beti theen. 'Abdullah 'Abdul-Muttalib ke beton mein sab se zaheen, sab se paak-daaman aur sab se zyada mehboob the. Wo wahi bete bhi the jin ki taraf qura ke teer ne ishaara kiya ke unhein Al-Ka'bah ke liye qurbaani ke taur par zibah kiya jaaye. Jab 'Abdul-Muttalib ke das bete hue aur wo baaligh hue, to unhone apni posheeda nazar un par zaahir ki jise unhone khaamoshi aur farma-bardaari se qubool kiya. Un ke naam qura ke teeron par likhe gaye aur un ke sab se mehboob but, Hubal, ke nigraan ko diye gaye. Teer phente gaye aur nikaale gaye. Ek teer ne dikhaaya ke 'Abdullah ko qurban kiya jaaye.

'Abdul-Muttalib phir larke ko ek ustre ke saath Al-Ka'bah le gaye taake larke ko zibah karein. Lekin Quraish, Makhzum qabeele se un ke chacha aur un ke bhai Abu Talib ne unhein un ke maqsad ko poora karne se baaz rakhne ki koshish ki. Phir unhone apni nazar ke baare mein un se mashwara maanga. Unhone tajweez ki ke wo ek kaahina ko bulaayein taake faisla kare ke kya kiya jaaye. Us ne hukm diya ke qura ke teer 'Abdullah ke saath saath das oonton ke baare mein bhi nikaale jaayein. Us ne mazeed kaha ke jab bhi teer 'Abdullah ko dikhaaye, to qura das aur oonton ke saath dohraaya jaaye. Yun amal dohraaya jaata raha yahan tak ke oonton ki taadaad ek sau tak pohnch gayi. Is muqaam par teer ne oonton ko dikhaaya, chunaancha un sab ko (Hubal ki khushnoodi ke liye) un ke bete ke bajaaye zibah kiya gaya. Zibah kiye gaye oont har kisi ke liye khaane ko chhor diye gaye, insaan ho ya jaanwar.

Is waaqie ne Arabia mein aam taur par qubool ki jaane waali diyat (khoon-baha) ki miqdaar mein tabdeeli paida ki. Wo das oont thi, lekin is waaqie ke baad ise barha kar ek sau kar diya gaya. Islam ne, baad mein, is ki tasdeeq ki. Ek aur cheez jo upar waale masle se gehri muta'alliq hai is mafhoom ki taraf jaati hai ke Nabi (Peace be upon him) ne ek baar farmaaya: "Main do zibah hone waalon ki aulaad hoon," ya'ni Ishmael aur 'Abdullah.

'Abdul-Muttalib ne Amina ko, jo Wahab bin 'Abd Munaf bin Zahra bin Kilab ki beti theen, apne bete 'Abdullah ke liye biwi ke taur par chuna. Yun wo, is khaandaani nasab ki roshni mein, martabe aur nasab ki sharaafat ke lihaaz se mumtaaz theen. Un ke walid Bani Zahra ke sardaar the jinhein bari izzat haasil thi. Un ki shaadi Makkah mein hui, aur is ke jald baad 'Abdullah ko un ke walid ne Madinah khajurein khareedne bheja jahan wo faut ho gaye. Ek aur riwayat mein, 'Abdullah tijaarat ke safar par Syria gaye aur wapsi par Madinah mein faut ho gaye. Unhein An-Nabigha Al-Ju'di ke ghar mein dafan kiya gaya. Wafaat ke waqt un ki umar pachchees saal thi. Aksar muarrikheen kehte hain ke un ki wafaat Muhammad [pbuh] ki wiladat se do maheene pehle thi. Kuch doosron ne kaha ke un ki wafaat Nabi ki wiladat ke do maheene baad thi. Jab Amina ko apne shauhar ki wafaat ki ittela di gayi, to unhone ek nihaayat dil ko chhoo lene waale martiye mein un ki yaad manaayi.
'Abdullah ne bohot kam daulat chhori — paanch oont, thori si bakriyaan, ek laundi, jise Barakah — Umm Aiman — kaha jaata tha, jo baad mein Nabi ki daaya (anna) ke taur par khidmat anjaam degi.

topics.topicSummary: Nabi ﷺ ka nasab teen tasdeeq-shuda hisson mein mila hai — yaqeen ke saath 'Adnan tak, phir Ishmael ke zariye Ibrahim (AS) tak, aur aage Adam (AS) tak. Hashimi khandan Hashim ke zariye milta hai, jinhone hujjaaj ko khaana khilaaya aur Quraish ke tijaarati safar shuru kiye, phir 'Abdul-Muttalib, jinhone Zamzam dobara daryaaft kiya aur Hathi waaqia dekha. 'Abdullah, Nabi ﷺ ke walid — 'Abdul-Muttalib ke beton mein sab se shareef — ko ek sau oonton se qurbaani se bachaaya gaya, phir 25 saal ki umar mein faut hue aur peeche sirf ek laundi, Umm Aiman, aur chand jaanwar chhore.
keyPoints: Nabi ﷺ ka silsila-nasab teen hisson par mushtamil hai: 'Adnan tak tasdeeq-shuda, Ibrahim (AS) tak mukhtalif-fiha, aur Adam (AS) tak juzwi taur par ghair-yaqeeni
Hashimi khandan ka naam Hashim bin 'Abd Munaf — Nabi ke par-daada — ke naam par hai

Hashim Ghazza, Palestine (497 A.D.) mein faut hue jabki un ki biwi 'Abdul-Muttalib se haamila theen — jin ki parwarish Madinah mein hui aur un ke Makki khandan ko un ka ilm nahi tha
'Abdul-Muttalib ne khwaab mein Zamzam kuwaan dobara daryaaft kiya, Jurhum ke dafan-shuda sone ke hiran aur talwarein paayeen

quiz.question: Nabi ﷺ ke silsila-nasab ka kaun sa hissa seerat-nigaron aur nasab-shanason ne tasdeeq-shuda maana hai?
Hashim ko yeh naam kyun diya gaya?
options: Kyunki wo pehle the jinhone Ka'bah ka darwaza banaaya
Kyunki un ki aadat hujjaaj ke liye roti chooran ki thi
Kyunki wo 'Abd Munaf ke beton mein sab se taaqatwar the
Kyunki unhone garmi aur sardi ke tijaarati safar shuru kiye
quiz.answer: Kyunki un ki aadat hujjaaj ke liye roti chooran ki thi

quiz.question: 'Abdul-Muttalib ko kaise pata chala ke Zamzam kuwaan kahan khodna hai?
options: Unhein Jurhum ke ek boorhe aadmi ne bataaya
Unhein Ka'bah ke qareeb dafan puraane naqshe mile
Bani Sa'd ke ek kaahin ne unhein theek jagah tak rehnumaai ki

quiz.question: Hathi waaqia Nabi ﷺ ki wiladat se kitne din pehle pesh aaya?
'Abdullah ko qurbaani se bachaane ke liye aakhir-kaar kitne oont zibah kiye gaye?
Nabi ﷺ ka kya matlab tha jab unhone farmaaya 'Main do zibah hone waalon ki aulaad hoon'?
options: Unhone apne do aabaa-o-ajdaad ki taraf ishaara kiya jo shaheed hue
Unhone Nabi Ishmael (AS) aur apne walid 'Abdullah ki taraf ishaara kiya
Unhone 'Abdul-Muttalib aur Hashim ki taraf ishaara kiya
Unhone apni wiladat par zibah kiye gaye do oonton ki taraf ishaara kiya
quiz.answer: Unhone Nabi Ishmael (AS) aur apne walid 'Abdullah ki taraf ishaara kiya
